newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers cut odds on Labour victory to 2-9.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers cut odds on Labour victory to 2-9.

text.p: British bookmakers William Hill on Friday cut the odds on the main opposition Labour party winning the forthcoming election to 2-9 from 1-4, after its crushing victory in the Wirral South parliamentary by-election.
Odds on the ruling Conservatives retaining power were pushed out to 11-4 from 5-2. A hung parliament where no party has a clear majority was rated a 3-1 chance.
The election must be held by May 22 and May 1 is strong favourite. Labour won the by-election by 7,888 votes after a swing of 17 percent.
